item.title: Tecrys 0.6.0 (build 27)
item.description:
• Springs in assemblies: compression and tension springs from a catalogue (or custom), their length set by the mates, with force and stress in the inspector.
  • Helix reference curve, and Sweep along a helix.
  • Drawings on Windows: the command bar (Model View, Projected View, Arrange Views), Smart Dimension, Note, Centre Line, Centre Mark, Section, Detail and Broken-out tools.
  • New Drawing on Windows: File ▸ New Drawing…, the welcome page and Make Drawing in part and assembly windows; the inspector and view menus edit drawings as on the Mac.
  • Windows assemblies: drag components within their mates, move and turn them with the triad, and make exploded views.
  • Assemblies open faster: their parts are rebuilt on all processor cores at once.
  • A drawing made on Windows finds its model on a Mac (and the other way round) when the model is next to it.

item.title: Tecrys 0.6.0 (build 21)
item.description:
• Mac and Windows now use the same icons and the same tooltips everywhere (#45): new icons for axes, planes, points, Normal To, Section View, Measure and the display styles.
  • Fixed components in an assembly are marked with a pin on both platforms (#45).
  • Hovered and selected planes are orange and 5 % opaque on both platforms (#35).
  • Windows: loose sketch points stay visible after the sketch is closed (#36).
  • Hole dialog: snap points catch the pointer from 16 px and show a ring of that reach (#37).
  • Axes are drawn dash-dotted: standard axes, axis features and pattern axes (#39).
  • Standard planes shown while making reference geometry no longer draw their axes (#40).
  • Equations: the note explains when to type “=” (#41).
  • Hole Builder, Drawing Templates, Material Library and the other sheets open maximised (#43).
  • Windows: drawings (.tcdrw) open, print and export as PDF; editing them stays on the Mac for now.

item.title: Tecrys 0.6.0 (build 20)
item.description:
• A new part opens looking at the three planes from the right and a little above, filling the view (#17).
  • The standard axes are drawn once each, dashed (#29).
  • A dialog's first value is selected when it opens, so you can type the number straight away (#34).
  • Enter confirms every dialog, from its fields, checkboxes or the viewport (#33).
  • Reference planes you show can be clicked in the viewport when choosing a sketch plane and in the Plane dialog (#30).
  • Windows: cosmetic threads are shown (thread texture and end circles); in Wireframe, threads show as a helix on both platforms (#32).
  • Hole dialog: the snap points of shown sketches appear at once (also circle quadrants, arc midpoints, ellipse foci); clicking a sketch in the feature tree puts a hole at each of its points and circle centres (#31).

item.title: Tecrys 0.6.0 (build 19)
item.description:
• Mouse: left drag draws a selection box (edges; left to right selects what is inside, right to left what it touches), middle drag orbits, Ctrl+middle drag pans, the right button does nothing for now (#15)
  • Wireframe shows the outlines of round faces, such as a cylinder's sides (#16)
  • Planes are 10 % see-through with dashed axes; the empty part's plane picker opens in an isometric view of the three planes (#17)
  • Windows: the body hides planes behind it and shows where a plane cuts through it; every shown plane carries its name (#18)
  • Sketch dimension values accept equations: the part's variables and the sketch's own D1, D2… (#24)
  • A sketch no longer stays selected after a feature is made or the body is clicked (#25)
  • Plane/Axis/Point dialog: Front, Top and Right Plane can be clicked, also on an empty part (#12)
  • Windows: the feature tree keeps its expanded groups (#13); a command bar button runs the variant it shows (#19); the dimension value field keeps the keyboard (#23)
  • Enter in a feature dialog's value field accepts the dialog (#14)
  • Sketch dimensions can be dragged with Smart Dimension too (#21); what Smart Dimension has picked is drawn in light orange (#22)
  • Up To faces, planes and vertices are highlighted in feature dialogs (#26)
  • Delete or Backspace deletes the feature selected in the tree (#27)
  • Fully defined sketch geometry is green (#28)

item.title: Tecrys 0.6.0 (build 17)
item.description:
• Hole Builder on Windows too: design custom holes by dragging their section, sort them into categories (Window ▸ Hole Builder).
  • Windows assemblies: linear and circular component patterns, Smart Fasteners, Interference, reference planes, axes and points, BOM and Standard Hardware.
  • Windows: closing a sketch turns to the isometric view, as on the Mac (#10).
  • Mac: the Hole Builder, Standard Hardware, Parts List, pattern, fastener and interference panels now share Windows' rules.

item.title: Tecrys 0.6.0 (build 16)
item.description:
• Front, Top and Right Plane are drawn stronger, with the X, Y and Z axes where they meet through the origin (#9).
  • Windows: the Hole dialog (hole, counterbore, countersink, tapped and custom holes from the standards), the same as on the Mac.
  • Windows: Tecrys Help (F1, Help menu and the welcome page).
  • Windows: a welcome page with New Part, New Assembly, Open, Help and recent files when no document is open (#8).
  • Windows: the standard planes light up under the pointer while you choose a sketch plane (#6).
  • Reference geometry dialogs no longer crash when a pick has no plane yet (#7).
  • Windows: the Configurations sheet works (it failed to open).

item.title: Tecrys 0.6.0 (build 14)
item.description:
• Reference geometry: planes tangent to cylinders, points at a distance along an edge, reference planes/axes/points in assemblies that follow their components (#3)
  • Feature dialogs put the keyboard in the first value (e.g. the extrude depth), so you can type it at once (#4)
  • Windows: Esc cancels an open feature dialog (#5)
  • Windows: Tecrys assemblies can be edited — component tree with menus, Insert Part, Delete, Save
  • Windows: Mates in assemblies (the same Mate tool as on the Mac; picked faces in orange, the first part see-through)
  • Windows: Measure and Section View in assemblies
  • Mac: Section View in assemblies
  • Selected mates: value, Suppressed, Flip Side/Alignment and Delete in the inspector on both platforms

item.title: Tecrys 0.6.0 (build 13)
item.description:
• Help ▸ Suggest a Feature… and Report a Problem… open a short form (your version and platform filled in)
  • New Help topic: Ideas and Problems
  • This is the first update delivered through Check for Updates — if you see this, updating works

item.title: Tecrys 0.6.0 (build 12)
item.description:
• First release with automatic updates: Tecrys ▸ Check for Updates… (Mac), Help ▸ Check for Updates… (Windows)
  • Material Library: search filters as you type; problems in the standards library are listed in the window
  • Your standards library (materials, holes, threads, hardware) is kept in your own folder and survives updates
  • Equations, Properties, Configurations and the Material Library work the same on Mac and Windows
  • "Made of" is now called "Material"
